# Public content owner regression references

These small tracked references allow ordinary public API and CLI/WASM tests to run without ignored experiment outputs.

`scenes.json` preserves all 34 exact requests and complete Rive/source-map outputs from the independently native-validated private r3 candidate. The source was `output/content-owner-candidate-preflight-r3/render-cases.json`; each reference comes from its named `request.json`, `scene.riv`, and `scene.map.json`. Frozen compiler SHA-256: `b4c46ff26a0a46af3b06bcffb3a337b88358ee116fd0ea922ce81f821af4e7b8`. R3 outputs reproduce r2 native evidence exactly. Three independently authored literal controls test computed CSS inheritance; they are not generated by the implementation.

These references preserve six known fractional paint failures. Exact output equality transfers the recorded evidence; it does not claim all Chrome paint comparisons pass. See `validation/content-owner-checkpoint-review.md` and `validation/content-owner-candidate-visual-review.md` for the limits of that evidence.

`bounds.json` preserves all 20 source-identical controls from `output/content-owner-bounds-r1/cases.json` (SHA-256 `a27008391009bf000c3fcfe7bcc47c99d3140fe2485cdee2a01b4b6a7d9ca44c`), with r3 admission expectations: 12 accepted and 8 rejected. They are compile-only overflow controls and must not be rendered.

`rejections.json` preserves the five proposed percentage/point mixtures from the tracked `validation/content-owner-cases.json`. The content-owner composition does not admit them.
